svg.title: Idea2Strategy · System Architecture
svg.desc: AWS development target runtime envelope with application, async and compute, and shared data and operations planes. All 28 components and 24 directed connections from the supplied draw.io source are retained. Solid lines denote request, data or work flow; dashed lines denote external or control paths. The Alpaca SIP loose endpoint and unconnected components are preserved as drawn.
